name: Algebra 1 Course Bank Profile
role: Course-specific Bank content/evidence authority layered under the current Framework. The next Bank PM revision will own the updated execution procedure.

instructional_spine.rule: Use exact current Unit Assessment Plans. Preserve Intro/Review/Mastery and stable canonical goal identity.
instructional_spine.downstream_alignment: Instructional/evidence artifacts trace to the Assessment Plan; do not preserve stale old-Bank routing simply because files exist.

bank_strategy.rule: Smaller authoritative Bank, not exhaustive inventory. Author strongest evidence first.
priority_order: CYU and WTC routes as retained course resources
other reusable content only when it earns a canonical Bank role
downstream_generated: Notes examples/YTI may be purpose-authored/refined when Notes are built
middle-practice formats such as stations, Find Someone Who, matching, sorting, task cards, partner sets, and whiteboards may be generated at artifact build time

retired_required_inventory: Practice Set 2 as a required canonical Bank destination
Practice Set 3 as a required canonical Bank destination
fixed six Example/YTI pairs per section as a Bank requirement
inventory_note: Exact counts for Practice 1, Extra Practice, CYU, WTC, game exports, and final Bank package structure are intentionally deferred to the upcoming Bank Map / Bank PM revision. Do not revive old counts by default.

warmups.storage_note: Whether Warm-Up questions are stored in the canonical Bank or generated through recurring-assessment planning is intentionally left to the next Bank/Map PM decision.

normal_pattern: 2 new evidence opportunities from current section Mastery Goal(s)/supporting I Cans
2 fresh parallel reassessments of the previous section official Exit new evidence jobs
exit_ticket.cross_unit: Unit N Section 1 normally reassesses Unit N-1 Section 5.
exit_ticket.u1_1: Opening exception intentionally deferred to Bank/Exit map; do not fake repeats.
exit_ticket.intro_review: Checked formatively elsewhere; targeted reteach/recovery checks can be generated on demand.

response_mode.blooket_exception: selected response allowed when an explicit Blooket route is retained

representations.rule: Use applicable forms substantively; no decorative quota. Translation among forms is required when the mapped I Can calls for it.

natural_parameters: Choose pedagogically natural values. Difficulty should come from Algebra rather than arbitrary number inflation.
